```yaml
name: CI & Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  ci:
    name: CI
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy,rustfmt
          override: true

      - name: Install cross (Linux/macOS)
        if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'
        run: cargo install cross

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-features

      - name: Build
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "windows-latest" ]; then
            cargo build --release
          else
            cross build --release
          fi

  release-linux-mac:
    name: Release (Linux & macOS)
    needs: ci
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        target:
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - x86_64-apple-darwin
          - aarch64-apple-darwin
    env:
      BIN_NAME: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true

      - name: Install cross
        run: cargo install cross

      - name: Build binary
        run: cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          TARGET=${{ matrix.target }}
          BUILD_DIR=target/${TARGET}/release
          tar -czf ${BIN_NAME}-${TARGET}.tar.gz -C ${BUILD_DIR} ${BIN_NAME}

      - name: Upload asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ env.BIN_NAME }}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz
          asset_name: ${{ env.BIN_NAME }}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

  release-windows:
    name: Release (Windows)
    needs: ci
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target: [x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]
    env:
      BIN_NAME: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true

      - name: Build binary
        run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Archive
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $target = "${{ matrix.target }}"
          $buildDir = "target\$target\release"
          $file = "${{ env.BIN_NAME }}.exe"
          Compress-Archive -Path "$buildDir\$file" -DestinationPath "${{ env.BIN_NAME }}-$target.zip"

      - name: Upload asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ${{ github.workspace }}\${{ env.BIN_NAME }}-${{ matrix.target }}.zip
          asset_name: ${{ env.BIN_NAME }}-${{ matrix.target }}.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip
```
